- **cust3** uses `prefix-list-filter CUST3-BLOCKS **exact**` (line 11 of mx1-running.conf) — this accepts only the exact prefix 10.103.0.0/24
- **cust7** uses `prefix-list-filter CUST7-BLOCKS **orlonger**` (line 2 of PROPOSED.set) — this accepts 10.107.0.0/24 and any more specific subnets
